version_note: v4 is v3 plus one crash fix, with no scientific change: the not-separable K12 branch looked up a K10 checkpoint that is not registered when the K10 pair is itself not separable, which raised KeyError and killed the two multi proximal workers of the v3 attempt. Milestone state hashes are now tracked for every reached milestone and looked up safely. The v3 attempt (commit 8d2147b) is retained whole under revision_week/outputs/phase4_solver_refinement_v2_attempt1_8d2147b and recorded in docs/ISSUES.md as I-PHASE4-003; the corrected run repeats all twelve planned positions under a single frozen code hash. v3 content, unchanged: (1) milestone separability - a K8/K10 pair is admissible only if the two solver states differ and both come from genuine continued refinement; identical states are recorded as milestone_not_separable and curvature stability is UNRESOLVED, never STABLE; (2) milestone chunk reduced to 50 nfev so a crossing is captured close to its threshold; (3) the binding verdict is evaluated at the deepest separable milestone (K10 preferred) and K12 is diagnostics-only, so it can never overturn a passed K10 state; (4) RAW_LOCAL_MINIMUM additionally requires raw objective stationarity, and raw Hessian positive definiteness is recorded separately as raw_hessian_spd; (5) the training-block fit gate is binding for both routes; (6) the stage wall cap and the task wall budget are enforced inside every residual/Jacobian evaluation, and the hard kill is the task budget plus a declared output-flush grace only; (7) a run lock and a no-overwrite guard; per-task code and protocol SHA256 are recorded; (8) validation reads evidence and is exercised by synthetic negative controls. The round-1 alpha selection of v1/v2 is withdrawn and re-derived mechanically under this version.
purpose: answer whether the raw physical objective itself can reach a high-quality stationary point
answer whether the current solver failed because it did not exploit the residual-sum-of-squares structure
if raw refinement is genuinely hard, answer whether a fixed-reference proximal objective yields repeatable stable analysis states without materially breaking the physical fit
not_this_phase: no new confirmation seeds before the solver reachability gate passes
no E2 locality, no E3 one-step, no SO-ADAPT resume
no claim that Route P success implies Route R success
no SO-vs-GN comparison, no parameter-error feedback into solver or alpha choice

centers.selection_rationale: fixed subset of previously failed fresh Phase-2 centers, two per problem, selected before any Phase-4 SO/GN comparison, not selected by SO performance
centers.phase3_outcome_context: routes A/B/C on these centers failed reachability in phase3_reachability_v1 (A: iteration_budget_exhausted with gradients 1e-6..1e-7; B/C: budget_exhausted); recorded as context only, never used to steer Phase 4

R.name: raw
R.note: residual definition, training points, weights and fixed physical parameters all from the historical payload; no reweighting

P.name: proximal
P.objective: L_gamma(theta; theta0, lambda0) = L(theta, lambda0) + gamma/2 * ||theta - theta0||^2
P.gamma_rule: gamma_i = alpha * lambda_max(J_theta(theta0)^T J_theta(theta0)) evaluated once at the archived theta0, fixed lambda0, before any Route P solve
P.gamma_frozen: alpha, lambda_max, gamma and hashes recorded in gamma_computation.json before solving; never recomputed or drifted afterwards
P.anchor_rule: theta0 is the archived network state and is never updated by the solve, curvature, HVP or perturbation branches

solver.milestone_chunk_note: 50 nfev chunks with repository gate checks between them; the crossing of a milestone target is captured close to its threshold instead of at the end of a long chunk
solver.staging: scipy 1.15.3 least_squares has no callback; each stage runs bounded max_nfev chunks with repository-side gate checks between chunks
solver.stopping_policy: only frozen protocol gates or recorded budgets; no silent retries, no mid-protocol tolerance changes
solver.stage_deadline_enforcement: the stage wall cap is enforced inside every residual/Jacobian evaluation through a composite deadline, so a chunk can never overrun the stage or task budget; an overrun aborts mid-chunk and the last completed iterate is recorded
solver.lm_note: method='lm' is allowed as a development-attachment route only; it never replaces the TRF main route and never triggers a protocol edit

stages.note: one shared nfev pool of 24000 across all stages; a stage that exhausts the pool leaves later stages not_attempted and recorded as such
stages.overshoot_policy: if the previous milestone state already satisfies this stage's target, the stage is NOT re-run on the identical state; the pair is recorded as milestone_not_separable, curvature stability is UNRESOLVED and no stability claim is made. Manufacturing evidence by re-solving an already converged state is forbidden.
stages.milestone_separability: a milestone pair is admissible only when the two recorded solver states differ (SHA256) and both were reached by continued refinement from the previous milestone; non-admissible pairs never set K8_saved/K10_saved and therefore never yield REFERENCE_CAPABLE
stages.binding_state_rule: the terminal status, diagnostics_after and physical-fit verdict are evaluated at the deepest admissible milestone (K10 when available, else K8, else the last solver state); the 1e-12 state is a non-binding diagnostic and never changes a passed 1e-8 + stable-K10 conclusion

gates.normalized_gradient: ||grad_theta L_sum|| / (m * max(||theta||, 1)) where L_sum is the sum-of-squares objective of the route
gates.stability_floor: lambda_min(A_target) > max(curvature_floor=0.0, eigenvalue numerical error bound) with the bound taken from the project's numerical_mu margin (eigen residual + orthogonality + asymmetry + 32*d*eps scale)

curvature_stability.unresolved_if: 1e-10 polish state not reached within the stage budget
curvature_stability.k12: additional diagnostic only; never overrides a passed 1e-8 + stable-K10 state

physical_fit.block_gate_scope: binding for BOTH routes (consistent treatment); a training block above the frozen +10% makes the task PHYSICAL_FIT_FAIL regardless of the raw total moving down

gates.route_R_loss_anomaly: Route R raw total loss relative increase > 0.05 is an anomaly -> NUMERICAL_FAILURE

curvature_definition.K: joint (theta, lambda) Hessian of the route's analysis objective at the checkpoint state; analysis objective is raw L for Route R and proximal L_gamma with the frozen gamma_solve for Route P
curvature_definition.binding_metric: relative Frobenius and spectral changes between K10 and K8
secondary_non_binding: F_star reduced Schur curvature and its eigenvalues
eta_state and eta_E Newton-state displacement diagnostics

labels.curvature_stability_pass_requirement: an admissible K8/K10 milestone pair (distinct states, genuine continued refinement) with both relative drift metrics <= 0.05; non-separable pairs and unreached polish states are UNRESOLVED, never STABLE
labels.RAW_LOCAL_MINIMUM: REFERENCE_CAPABLE and the raw theta-block Hessian resolvably SPD (raw_hessian_spd) and RAW OBJECTIVE stationarity (normalized raw gradient <= binding gate); a proximal stationary point is never a raw local minimum
labels.raw_hessian_spd: separate diagnostic flag recording only the raw theta-block positive definiteness

decision_precedence: NUMERICAL_FAILURE: non-finite residual/gradient/Hessian at any recorded state, or Route R raw loss anomaly
RESOURCE_LIMIT: binding 1e-8 gate not reached because nfev pool or task wall budget exhausted
STATIONARITY_FAIL: scipy terminated on its own frozen criteria while the binding gate remained unmet (gradient stagnation)
STABILITY_FAIL: gate reached but the route stability matrix is not resolvably positive
CURVATURE_STABILITY_UNRESOLVED: gate + stability ok but the 1e-10 polish state not reached
CURVATURE_UNSTABLE: K10 reached but relative curvature drift > 0.05
PHYSICAL_FIT_FAIL: gate + stability + curvature ok but a frozen physical-fit gate violated (Route P)
PASS: all binding checks passed; REFERENCE_CAPABLE label recorded, RAW_LOCAL_MINIMUM if additionally raw-SPD

resources.hard_kill_note: the worker deadline is the task budget (600s), enforced inside every evaluation; the systemd RuntimeMaxSec is task budget + a declared 60s output-flush grace and is a kill-on-hang backstop, not a solver budget
resources.no_overwrite: an existing task directory with claim.json blocks the run; results are never silently overwritten
resources.run_lock: an exclusive lock under the output namespace prevents concurrent controllers
resources.scheduler_note: concurrency is an upper bound; if host memory cannot hold 6x4GiB the scheduler lowers concurrency, never the per-task limit

scipy_env_policy: record python/numpy/scipy/torch/BLAS versions before the first numerical task; do not upgrade scipy mid-phase; if missing, install and lock, and keep installation outside timed solve sections
scipy_success_not_binding: scipy_success != scientific_binding_valid; scipy only returns a candidate state and the repository's own diagnostics decide usability
diagnostics_saved: raw total loss (sum) before/after and mean
PDE / data / initial / boundary training-block residual norms (weighted blocks as defined by the payload)
state/output RMSE only if present in the payload
normalized gradient (route objective), raw gradient norm and proximal gradient norm separately for Route P
lambda_min_H_raw, lambda_min_A_fd, lambda_min_H_prox (Route P) and numerical floors
eta_state, eta_E, theta_displacement, relative_theta_displacement, proximal_term (diagnostics only, never promoted to gates after seeing results)

alpha_grid.status: deferred; may start only after the 12 minimal contrast tasks complete and per Section 13 conditions
grid_start_conditions: Route P nominal alpha already successful on >= 4/6 centers and a milder alpha is to be evaluated
or Route P nominal alpha close to success with predefined diagnostics indicating the limiter is lambda_min near zero, not physical-fit or numerical failure

unknown_attempts.reason: the protocol-v2 twelve-task outputs were overwritten in place by the attempt-3 re-run before the overwrite hazard was fixed; only the terminal-status log survived, so its numeric artifacts and cost are unrecoverable and are never reported as zero

cost_ledger.unknown_marking: an overwritten or lost attempt is recorded as UNKNOWN with a reason, never as zero

validation.method: evidence-based assertions over saved artifacts, not self-declaration
assertions: every planned position has a terminal status and a process record
no process failure coexists with a terminal claim
a STABLE curvature label requires an admissible (distinct-state) K8/K10 pair
a raw_local_minimum label requires raw objective stationarity
raw and proximal objectives recompute from theta_final within tolerance
lambda_max and the gamma rule recompute from the archived theta0
protocol and per-task code hashes match the frozen values
every cost scope is listed and lost attempts are marked UNKNOWN
validation.negative_controls: tests/test_validation_negatives.py exercises identical K8/K10 states, a wrong raw-local-minimum label, a tampered gamma, a missing process record and a failed process with a terminal claim; each must make the audit fail

git_policy.push_policy: local commits only; push/merge requires explicit user authorization
